schema: Top model keys index/name/center/lods/proxies; all nested keys exact observed structure. Finite numeric center3/matrix12 and resolution, no bool. Faces/counts/indices exact integers. LOD sections counts sum to declared faces but no face membership proof. Ordinal route slots never model index. Normalize ASCII slash/case/outer slash without suffix insertion; all model/proxy names must end .p3d. Expected model/route/face rows strict; compare complete face multiset including duplicates and route ordinal/order, preserve input order in returned rows. Output includes exact limitations from oracle, status FIXTURE_FACE_ROUTE_IDENTITY_ONLY. No JSON fields silently ignored.
API: validate_face_routes(sections,routes,face_records,expected); load_fixture(path,expected_sha256). load_fixture is synthetic loader only: cap before parse, duplicate keys/nonfinite rejected, complete SHA required; no historical file identity claim.
role: Codex explicitly assigned local executor, same-context integrator; native Muse reviewer
